results.rule_description: VPC flow logs should be enabled for all subnetworks
results.description: Subnetwork does not have VPC flow logs enabled.
results.review: No deployment; no flow-log sink or recurring logging cost. Reassess logging/retention before production. Existing free host/application monitoring is the reference boundary.

results.rule_description: Instances should not have public IP addresses
results.impact: Direct exposure of an instance to the public internet
results.description: Instance has a public IP allocated.
results.review: Intentional single-host HTTP ingress and explicit /32 management allowlist. A public IP is necessary for this reference without a billable load balancer/NAT. No backend ports. Not a private-only production workload.

results.rule_description: VM disks should be encrypted with Customer Supplied Encryption Keys
results.impact: Using unmanaged keys does not allow for proper management
results.description: Instance disk encryption does not use a customer managed key.
results.review: Use provider-managed encryption at rest. Customer-managed keys add IAM, lifecycle and potential cost obligations not justified for public static-content reference. Reassess for sensitive data.
